historical_significance: 伊克巴尔（1877-1938），20 世纪最具影响力的穆斯林思想家之一、诗人、哲学家与政治家，被誉为「东方诗人」（Shair-e-Mashriq）与「乌玛的智者」（Hakeem-ul-Ummat）。生于英属印度旁遮普的锡亚尔科特（Sialkot），先后受教于拉合尔政府学院、剑桥三一学院与慕尼黑大学（1907 年获博士学位，论文《波斯形而上学的发展》首次向西方系统介绍苏哈拉瓦迪、莫拉·萨德拉等波斯思想人物），并在伦敦林肯律师学院取得律师资格。1915 年以波斯文出版《自我的秘密》，创立以「胡迪」（khudi，自我锻造）为核心的自我哲学：人的道德—宗教理想不是自我否定而是自我肯定；此后《无我之秘》《东方之信》《钟声集》《加百列的翅膀》等构成横跨波斯语与乌尔都语的庞大诗性哲学体系。1930 年出版《宗教思想重建》，以「伊智提哈德（创制）」为伊斯兰结构的运动原则，主张以现代知识与哲学重建宗教思想。1930 年 12 月在全印穆斯林联盟阿拉哈巴德年会主席演讲中提出「穆斯林印度中的穆斯林」与西北四省合并构想，被视为巴基斯坦运动的思想奠基；他在乌尔都语—波斯语世界被尊为巴基斯坦的「精神之父」。1938 年 4 月 21 日逝于拉合尔，葬于巴德夏希清真寺旁。
core_thoughts: 自我锻造法（Khudi）——以自我肯定替代自我消解，三阶段（服从、自控、代治）锻造人格
宗教思想重构法——以伊智提哈德为运动原则，重启对经典的创造性诠释
经验与科学对话法——宗教经验作为知识，与现代科学双向对话
东西互文对话法——以《东方之信》回应歌德，平等交换文明的礼物
共同体融入法——个体在共同体（millat）中完成第二次自我实现
政治构想设计法——把哲学愿景转译为可谈判的宪政架构（阿拉哈巴德方案）
意象铸造法——以「隼鹰」「信士之人」等意象把哲学下沉为大众符号
历史精神重读法——以「行先于思」的经验精神重读文明兴衰
分层语域书写法——波斯语、乌尔都语、英语三层受众分写
未来世代召唤法——以「明日之诗」与青年教育向未来说话

influence: 伊克巴尔的思想与诗作在其身后持续放大：《自我的秘密》经尼科尔森（1920）译入英语后进入世界学术视野，《宗教思想重建》成为现代伊斯兰思想的关键文本；其波斯语诗歌使他在伊朗获得「拉合尔的伊克巴尔」（Iqbal Lahori）之名，并影响了阿里·沙里亚蒂等后来的伊斯兰复兴思想家；阿伯里（1966）、席梅尔、鲍萨尼等译本把他的天界行纪推向德语、意大利语与土耳其语读者。巴基斯坦独立后，他被正式尊为「巴基斯坦的思想奠基者」（Muffakir-e-Pakistan），拉合尔建有陵墓（Mazar-e-Iqbal），设有伊克巴尔学院（1951）与全民教育机构阿拉马·伊克巴尔开放大学（1974），11 月 9 日为「伊克巴尔日」。其「自我锻造」命题至今活跃于南亚教育、社会运动与文化记忆之中。

cross_references.description_zh: 甘地与伊克巴尔同为英属印度反殖民语境中的精神型领袖，但路径相反：甘地以非暴力群众运动与「印度是一个民族」的道德普世主义凝聚多元印度；伊克巴尔则从「诸共同体的洲陆」判断出发，走向穆斯林共同体的自决与单独政治架构。两人都以精神性批评现代物质文明，却在「印度统一」问题上给出对立答案。
cross_references.description_en: Gandhi and Iqbal were both spiritual-minded leaders in British India, yet their paths diverge: Gandhi mobilized a non-violent mass movement on the moral universalism of one Indian nation; Iqbal, judging India a continent of communities, moved toward Muslim communal self-determination and a separate political framework. Both criticized modern materialism in spiritual terms, but answered the question of Indian unity in opposite ways.

cross_references.description_zh: 凯末尔与伊克巴尔同为战后穆斯林世界的「改革设计师」：凯末尔以国家权力自上而下推行世俗化，把土耳其改造成民族国家；伊克巴尔则在《宗教思想重建》中援引土耳其的创制经验，主张以「重建宗教思想」而非废除宗教来完成复兴。前者以世俗化著称，后者以宗教的自我更新著称，构成同一时代两种现代性方案。
cross_references.description_en: Atatürk and Iqbal were both reform designers of the post-war Muslim world: Atatürk secularized from above, remaking Turkey as a nation-state; Iqbal, citing Turkey's experience of ijtihad, sought revival through the reconstruction of religious thought rather than its abolition. One is remembered for secularization, the other for religious self-renewal—two rival modernities of one age.

cross_references.description_zh: 伊本·赫勒敦与伊克巴尔都试图为文明的兴衰找出动力学：赫勒敦以「阿萨比亚」（群体凝聚）解释王朝循环，伊克巴尔以「胡迪」（自我锻造）与「创制」解释文明的停滞与复兴。前者以社会学分析写成《历史绪论》，后者以诗与哲学讲座重建同一问题的现代版本。
cross_references.description_en: Ibn Khaldun and Iqbal both sought the dynamics of civilizational rise and fall: Khaldun explained dynastic cycles through 'asabiyya (group solidarity), while Iqbal explained stagnation and revival through khudi (self-forging) and ijtihad. The former wrote the Muqaddimah as sociological analysis; the latter reconstructed the same question for the modern age in poetry and philosophical lectures.

modes.definition_zh: 以「胡迪」（khudi，自我）为轴心的自我锻造方法：拒绝「自我消解/寂灭」（fanā）式的神秘主义与泛神论，主张人的道德—宗教理想是自我肯定、自我塑造与自我扩张；个体通过变得「越来越个别、越来越独特」而接近神性，最终成为「神的代治者」（niyābat-i ilāhī）。伊克巴尔把自我理解为一种「张力状态」：维持张力即维持人格，凡增强自我者为善、削弱自我者为恶；并在《自我的秘密》中给出三阶段锻造路线——服从律法（ita'at）、自我克制（zabt-e-nafs）、神圣代治（niyabat-i ilahi），以爱（ishq）为燃料。其逻辑内核：宇宙仍在形成之中，人参与创化，因此提升自我不是自私，而是宇宙性义务。
modes.definition_en: A self-forging method centred on khudi (the self): it rejects self-annihilation (fana) and pantheistic absorption, holding that man's moral-religious ideal is self-affirmation, self-shaping and self-expansion—by becoming 'more and more individual, more and more unique' one approaches the divine and becomes God's vicegerent (niyabat-i ilahi). Iqbal treats the self as a state of tension whose maintenance is personality itself: what fortifies the self is good, what weakens it is evil; The Secrets of the Self lays out three stages—obedience to the law, self-control, divine vicegerency—fuelled by love ('ishq). Core logic: the universe is still in the making and man shares in creation, so strengthening the self is a cosmic duty, not selfishness.
modes.source_chapter: 《自我的秘密》（Asrār-i Khudī, 1915，波斯文；Nicholson 英译 The Secrets of the Self, Macmillan, 1920）导言与作者致译者的哲学说明（英译本 pp. xvi-xxiii）；《加百列的翅膀》第 53 首（1935）；《宗教思想重建》第 4 讲『人的自我——其自由与不朽』
modes.key_quote_zh: 「人类的道德与宗教理想不是自我否定，而是自我肯定；人通过变得越来越个别、越来越独特而抵达这一理想。」（伊克巴尔致尼科尔森的哲学说明，载《自我的秘密》英译本导言，1920）
modes.key_quote_en: 'The moral and religious ideal of man is not self-negation but self-affirmation, and he attains to this ideal by becoming more and more individual, more and more unique.' (Iqbal's own statement to R. A. Nicholson, in the Introduction to The Secrets of the Self, 1920)
process_zh: 确立「自我真实」前提：承认自我（khudi）是真实而可经验的存在，拒绝把个体视为幻象
以爱（ishq）为燃料：把爱理解为同化、吸收与价值创造的欲望，用它驱动自我成长
阶段一·服从律法：在神法之内训练意志，获得行动的方向与约束
阶段二·自我克制：以自控维持人格张力，避免松弛与消散
阶段三·神圣代治：把锻造完成的自我投入世界，成为神在大地上的代治者
持续行动与创造：以不断创造欲望与理想保持自我运动，直至定数在自身面前发问
process_en: Start from the reality of the self: accept khudi as real and experienceable, refusing to treat the individual as illusion
Fuel with love ('ishq): understand love as the desire to assimilate, absorb and create values, and use it to drive growth
Stage one - obedience to the law: train the will within divine law to gain direction and discipline
Stage two - self-control: maintain the tension of personality, avoiding relaxation and dissolution
Stage three - divine vicegerency: send the forged self into the world as God's vicegerent on earth
Keep acting and creating: sustain the self's movement through the continual creation of desires and ideals, until destiny itself asks for the self's wish
representative_cases_zh: 《自我的秘密》（1915）与「自我肯定」纲领：全书以「存在之形是自我的效果，你所见皆为自我的秘密」立论，公开反驳消解自我的静观传统与泛神论路线
三阶段锻造框架：伊克巴尔应尼科尔森之请写下哲学说明，明确 (a) 服从 (b) 自控 (c) 代治 三阶段，并称代治是「人类在地球上发展的第三也是最后阶段」
「胡迪」名句：《加百列的翅膀》第 53 首——「把自我锻造得如此之高：在每一定数降临之前，神会亲自问仆人：说出你的愿望」（1935）
representative_cases_en: The Secrets of the Self (1915) and the self-affirmation programme: the poem opens by asserting that 'the form of existence is an effect of the Self; whatsoever thou seest is a secret of the Self', openly rejecting the quietist and pantheistic routes of self-dissolution

The three-stage framework: at Nicholson's request Iqbal wrote out his philosophical statement naming the stages (a) obedience (b) self-control (c) divine vicegerency, calling the last 'the third and last stage of human development on earth'
The famous khudi couplet: Bal-i-Jibril No. 53—'Raise the self so high that before every decree God Himself asks the servant: tell me, what is your wish' (1935)

modern_applications_en: Building psychological resilience and a sense of meaning

modes.domain_zh: 宗教思想与法理/现代性
modes.definition_zh: 以「伊智提哈德」（ijtihad，独立判断/创制）为引擎对宗教思想进行开放式再诠释：伊克巴尔在《宗教思想重建》中判定，伊斯兰结构中的「运动原则」就是伊智提哈德——创制之门从未应被关闭。方法要求：区分「永恒的核心」与「可变的形式」（伊斯兰之精神永恒，但显现于多样与变动之中）；把古兰经读作「原则与精神」而非凝固的法典；承认早期穆斯林共同体正是靠持续创制而扩展；并以土耳其等现代改革为参照，主张在立法、教育与社会制度上重启集体创制。其写作姿态是「重建」而非「革命」：在承认伊斯兰哲学传统的前提下用现代知识重述信仰，并明言一切重建永无终稿。
modes.definition_en: A method of open-ended re-interpretation driven by ijtihad (independent reasoning): in The Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam Iqbal argues that the 'principle of movement' in Islam's structure is ijtihad—the gate of interpretation was never meant to be closed. It requires distinguishing the eternal core from changeable forms (the spirit of Islam is eternal yet reveals itself in variety and change), reading the Qur'an as principle and spirit rather than a frozen legal code, recognizing that the early community expanded precisely through continuous ijtihad, and—citing modern Turkey—restarting collective ijtihad in law, education and social institutions. Its stance is reconstruction, not revolt: restating faith in the light of modern knowledge while conceding that no philosophical formulation is final.
modes.source_chapter: 《宗教思想重建》第 6 讲『伊斯兰结构中的运动原则』（The Principle of Movement in the Structure of Islam）；前言；第 1 讲
modes.key_quote_zh: 「依伊斯兰所理解，一切生命的终极精神基础是永恒的，并在多样与变动中展现自身。一个建立在这种实在观之上的社会，必须在自己的生活中调和『永常』与『变易』两个范畴。」（《宗教思想重建》第 6 讲）
modes.key_quote_en: 'The ultimate spiritual basis of all life, as conceived by Islam, is eternal and reveals itself in variety and change. A society based on such a conception of Reality must reconcile, in its life, the categories of permanence and change.' (The Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam, Lecture VI)
process_zh: 诊断停滞：把穆斯林社会的僵化归因于创制中止（taqlid）与思想封闭
划定边界：区分不可变的核心原则与可变的制度形式
重读经典：把古兰经理解为唤起人与神、人与创造之关系意识的原则文本，而非逐条法典
重启创制：主张以集体判断应对新情境，法律、教育、文化一并重估
参照实例：援引土耳其改革（如 Halim Sabit 以现代社会学概念奠基的法学新论）作为创制仍可运作的现世证据
保持开放：声明一切重建皆非终稿，随知识进展不断修正
process_en: Diagnose stagnation: attribute the ossification of Muslim society to the suspension of ijtihad (taqlid) and closed thought
Draw boundaries: separate unchanging core principles from changeable institutional forms
Re-read the source: treat the Qur'an as a principle-text that awakens consciousness of man's relation to God and creation, not as an itemized legal code
Restart ijtihad: call for collective judgement on new situations, re-evaluating law, education and culture together
Cite working examples: invoke Turkish reforms (e.g. Halim Sabit's new theory of law grounded in modern sociology) as present-day evidence that ijtihad still functions
Stay open: declare that no reconstruction is final and that positions must be revised as knowledge advances
representative_cases_zh: 『创制即运动原则』论断：第 6 讲设问『那么，伊斯兰本质中的运动原则是什么？这就是伊智提哈德』，并以早期共同体对新情境的持续裁断证明其可行性
土耳其参照：以土耳其宗教与政治思想中创制的复活（含 Halim Sabit 的法学新论）论证『伊斯兰的复兴是事实』
前言中的自我定位：把讲座称为『部分地』回应『对科学形态的宗教知识的正当要求』，并声明『哲学思考没有终局』
representative_cases_en: The 'ijtihad as principle of movement' thesis: Lecture VI asks 'What then is the principle of movement in the nature of Islam? This is ijtihad', backing it with the early community's continuous rulings for new situations
The Turkish reference: the revival of ijtihad in Turkish religious and political thought (including Halim Sabit's new theory of law) is used as evidence that 'the renaissance of Islam is a fact'

The preface's self-positioning: the lectures are offered as a partial answer to 'the demand for a scientific form of religious knowledge', with the caveat that 'there is no such thing as finality in philosophical thinking'
modern_applications_zh: 宗教改革与教法现代化讨论
传统组织的渐进式变革
文化遗产的创造性转化
modern_applications_en: Religious reform and legal modernization debates

verification.evidence: The Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam（1930/1934 版网络全文，含第 6 讲）；csss-isla 评论（Iqbal and Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam）；drsalah PDF 前言文本；Routledge / muslimphilosophy H037

modes.name_en: Religious Experience and Science Dialogue Method
modes.definition_zh: 把宗教经验当作可检验的知识来源，与现代科学展开双向对话：伊克巴尔拒绝「宗教=私人感情」的近代划分，主张宗教经验是一种「知识」，可以被哲学检验；同时对科学的自足宣称保持警惕——认知（aql）与爱（ishq）相辅相成，「没有爱，理性会变得恶魔性」。方法上他抓住 20 世纪初物理学的自我批判（经典物理检讨自身基础、唯物论退潮）判定「宗教与科学相互发现前所未见的和谐」为期不远，并借相对论、量论与过程哲学重述「创造的宇宙」。目标是让宗教知识获得「科学形态」，而不沦为科学的附庸。
modes.definition_en: Treating religious experience as a testable source of knowledge and opening a two-way dialogue with modern science: Iqbal rejects the modern division of religion as private feeling and argues that religious experience is a form of knowledge open to philosophical test; at the same time he guards against science's self-sufficiency—intellect (aql) and love (ishq) are organically related, for without love reason becomes demonic. Methodologically he seizes on early-20th-century physics' self-criticism (classical physics criticizing its own foundations; materialism receding) to judge that 'the day is not far off when Religion and Science may discover hitherto unsuspected mutual harmonies', restating a universe of continuous creation via relativity, quantum theory and process philosophy. The aim is a scientific form of religious knowledge without subordinating revelation to materialism.
modes.source_chapter: 《宗教思想重建》前言；第 1 讲『知识与宗教经验』；第 2 讲『对宗教经验启示的哲学检验』；第 7 讲『宗教是可能的吗？』
modes.key_quote_zh: 「经典物理学已学会批判自身的基础。由于这种批判，它最初所催生的那种唯物论正在迅速消退；宗教与科学相互发现前所未见的和谐，已为期不远。」（《宗教思想重建》前言）
modes.key_quote_en: 'Classical Physics has learned to criticize its own foundations. As a result of this criticism the kind of materialism, which it originally necessitated, is rapidly disappearing; and the day is not far off when Religion and Science may discover hitherto unsuspected mutual harmonies.' (Preface, The Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam)
process_zh: 拆解二分：拒绝「精神—物质」「宗教—科学」的僵硬二分，指出其为欧洲特定历史的产物
提升经验：把宗教经验视为可描述、可检验的内在经验事实
哲学检验：对启示的宗教经验进行哲学审查，厘清其认识论地位
借力科学：引用现代物理与过程哲学说明『宇宙仍在生成』，为动态信仰观提供接口
双引擎认识：以理性（aql）与爱（ishq）互补，防止理性独大导致的去人性化
重提可能性问题：把『宗教是否可能』重述为——在科学时代，宗教能否作为更高层级的经验与知识继续可能
process_en: Dismantle the dichotomy: reject the rigid split between spirit and matter, religion and science, as a product of particular European history
Elevate experience: treat religious experience as a describable, testable fact of inner life
Philosophical test: submit the religious experience of revelation to philosophical scrutiny and clarify its epistemic status
Borrow from science: cite modern physics and process philosophy to restate a universe still in the making, giving dynamism to faith
Two engines of knowing: hold reason (aql) and love (ishq) as organically related, guarding against dehumanizing rationalism
Re-pose the question: restate 'Is religion possible?' as whether, in the scientific age, religion can remain possible as a higher order of experience and knowledge
representative_cases_zh: 前言的科学判断：以『经典物理学自我批判—唯物论退潮』为据，预告宗教与科学的『未见和谐』
第 7 讲『宗教是可能的吗？』（1934 年增补）：把宗教可能性重述为经验与知识的层级问题，直接回应科学时代
两重知识论：把知识定义为『经理解阐明的感知』，将感觉、理性和直觉纳入统一的知识理论（转引自 Routledge H037）
representative_cases_en: The preface's scientific judgement: citing classical physics' self-criticism and the recession of materialism to foresee 'unsuspected mutual harmonies' between religion and science
Lecture VII 'Is Religion Possible?' (added 1934): restating the possibility of religion as a question of levels of experience and knowledge in the scientific age
A two-source epistemology: defining knowledge as 'sense-perception elaborated by understanding', integrating sense, reason and intuition into one theory of knowledge (per Routledge H037)

verification.evidence: The Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam 前言全文（nasirlawsite / scribd / exoticindia 转录互证）；Routledge / muslimphilosophy H037；Britannica 'Muhammad Iqbal'

modes.definition_zh: 以「互文答复」的方式与西方展开平等对话：伊克巴尔把歌德的《西东合集》当作西方递给东方的「花束」，以《东方之信》（1923）逐节回应，既致敬又校正——承认西方活力（动力学、科学与生命冲动哲学），批判其物质主义与精神空洞；主张东方以「爱、内在性与价值创造」回礼。方法要点：选择与对方同构的文本形式（对诗集答诗集）；用对话体而非论战体；在赞美与批判之间保持双重姿态；通过翻译与出版（尼科尔森、阿伯里、席梅尔等）让对话跨语言延续。
modes.definition_en: An equal-footed dialogue through intertextual reply: Iqbal took Goethe's West-Eastern Divan as the West's 'bouquet' to the East and answered it section by section in Payam-i-Mashriq (1923)—paying homage while correcting: acknowledging Western vitality (dynamics, science, the philosophy of vital impulse) yet criticizing its materialism and spiritual void, and offering the East's counter-gift of love, inwardness and value-creation. Method: choose formal counterparts (poems answering poems), prefer dialogue over polemic, hold homage and critique in one gesture, and let translation (Nicholson, Arberry, Schimmel) carry the conversation across languages.
modes.source_chapter: 《东方之信》（Payām-i Mašriq, 1923）献诗与诸篇；R. A. Nicholson 书评『Iqbal's Message of the East』（allamaiqbal.com 辑录）；《加百列游记》欧洲相关篇章；Encyclopaedia Iranica 传记部分
modes.key_quote_zh: 「西方的智者、那位迷恋波斯魅力的德国诗人，描绘了那些娇媚的美人，给东方捎来欧洲的问候。为答复他，我写下了《东方之信》；我为东方的黄昏洒下了月光。」（《东方之信》献诗，尼科尔森英译）
modes.key_quote_en: 'The Sage of the West, the German poet who was fascinated by the charms of Persia, Depicted those coy and winsome beauties and gave the East a greeting from Europe. In reply to him I have composed the Payam-i-Mashriq: I have shed moonbeams o'er the evening of the East.' (Payam-i-Mashriq, dedicatory poem, tr. R. A. Nicholson)
process_zh: 选定对话者与文本：把歌德《西东合集》视为可对话的对象
镜像回应：以同样体量与结构作答，构成『东方的回信』
承认活力：公开承认西方在科学与行动上的优长
批判空洞：指出物质主义导致的『有学问而无心』（『积累学识，却丢了心』）
提出回礼：以爱、内在超越与共同体伦理作为东方的礼物
延续对话：借翻译与友人网络把对话推至跨世纪
process_en: Choose the interlocutor and the text: treat Goethe's West-Eastern Divan as a partner for dialogue
Mirror the reply: answer in matching scale and structure, composing an 'Eastern letter' back
Concede vitality: openly acknowledge Western strengths in science and action
Critique the void: name the heartlessness bred by materialism ('amassing lore, thou hast lost thy heart')
Offer the counter-gift: love, inward transcendence and communal ethics as the East's present
Extend the conversation: use translations and scholarly friendships to carry it across generations
representative_cases_zh: 《东方之信》（1923）：逐篇回应歌德，自称『月光洒向东方黄昏』；学界评价其『在东西方之间架桥』
对话体短章：『我说：它来自土，归于土；他说：种子破土，就是玫瑰』——以两行诗完成两种宇宙观的对话（尼科尔森译文）
与欧洲思想者的直接接触：巴黎访柏格森与马西尼翁；西班牙访阿辛·帕拉西奥斯并写下科尔多瓦清真寺名篇（1933 年旅行，见 Iranica）
representative_cases_en: Payam-i-Mashriq (1923): a section-by-section answer to Goethe, self-described as 'moonbeams o'er the evening of the East'; scholarship calls him a bridge-builder between East and West
The dialogic couplet: 'Said I, of earth it comes, to earth it goes; Said he, the seed bursts earth, and is the rose'—two cosmologies meeting in two lines (Nicholson's translation)
Direct encounters: meeting Bergson and Massignon in Paris; meeting Asin Palacios in Spain and writing the celebrated Cordoba Mosque poem (1933 journey, per Iranica)
modern_applications_zh: 跨文明对话与公共外交
品牌与文化的互文表达
modern_applications_en: Intertextual expression in brand and culture work

verification.evidence: Nicholson 'Iqbal's Message of the East'（allamaiqbal.com 辑录，含献诗与对话诗英译）；Grokipedia 'Message from the East'；Encyclopaedia Iranica 'IQBAL, MUHAMMAD'；nazariapak 资料

modes.category_raw: 共同体理论/伊斯兰社会思想
modes.domain_zh: 社会哲学/个体与共同体
modes.definition_zh: 把个体自我放进共同体（millat）之中完成「第二次锻造」：伊克巴尔在《无我之秘》（1918）中提出，个体若只知自我扩张会滑向自利，唯有在与信仰共同体的联结中才能获得真正的自我实现——「无我」（bekhudi）不是消解个体，而是以共同体的更高生命为个体赋能。方法上：以先知共同体为理想型，强调平等、互助与法治（伊斯兰『既非纯粹的教会、也非纯粹的国家』）；以《怨诉/答复》式的对话结构唤醒共同体自省；批判资本与剥削造成的社会撕裂；在政治讲坛上声明『伊斯兰不是私人意见，而是一个社会，或可称公民教会』。
modes.definition_en: Placing the individual self within the community (millat) for its second forging: in Rumuz-i-Bekhudi (1918) Iqbal argues that self-expansion alone slides into selfishness—only in union with the community of faith does the self reach fulfilment; 'selflessness' (bekhudi) does not dissolve the individual but empowers it through the community's higher life. Method: hold up the Prophet's community as ideal type, stressing equality, mutual aid and law (Islam is neither a pure church nor a pure state); wake the community through dialogic structures such as Shikwa and Jawab-e-Shikwa, in which God answers the poet's complaint that the Muslims themselves have strayed; criticize capitalism and exploitation as social dissolution; and declare on the political platform that 'Islam is not a matter of private opinion. It is a society, or if you like, a civic Church.'
modes.source_chapter: 《无我之秘》（Rumūz-i Bekhudī, 1918）；《怨诉》（Shikwa, 1909 创作）与《答复》（Jawab-e-Shikwa, 1913）；1932 年拉合尔演讲（转引自 Routledge/muslimphilosophy H037）；《宗教思想重建》相关章节
modes.key_quote_zh: 「若你忠于穆罕默德，我们便属于你；这世界算什么——天牌与神笔都属于你。」（《答复》，载《钟声集》）
modes.key_quote_en: 'If you are faithful to Muhammad, we are yours; what is this world worth? The Preserved Tablet and the Pen are yours.' (Jawab-e-Shikwa, in Bang-e-Dara)
process_zh: 承认个体局限：指出纯粹自我扩张会走向自利与孤立
嵌入共同体：把个体接入以信仰为纽带的共同体（millat）
以理想型校准：以先知共同体的平等与互助为规范尺度
对话式唤醒：用《怨诉—答复》结构让共同体在自我诘问中苏醒
制度性表达：在政治讲坛上把共同体理想翻译为宪法与权利语言
约束经济撕裂：批判资本剥削，主张让弱者分享共同体的果实
process_en: Admit the limits of the individual: pure self-expansion slides into selfishness and isolation
Embed in the community: connect the self to the community of faith (millat)
Calibrate by the ideal type: use the Prophet's community—equality and mutual aid—as the norm
Awaken dialogically: use the Shikwa/Jawab-e-Shikwa structure to let the community wake through self-questioning
Give institutional expression: translate communal ideals into constitutional and rights language on the political platform
Restrain economic fracture: criticize capitalist exploitation and insist the weak share in the community's fruits
representative_cases_zh: 《无我之秘》（1918）：与《自我的秘密》构成对偶——尼科尔森指出『前者处理个体穆斯林的生活，后者处理伊斯兰共同体的生活』
《怨诉》与《答复》（1909/1913）：以『向神抱怨—神作答』的戏剧结构迫使共同体自省，神答『是你们自己背离了道路』；1913 年在拉合尔莫奇门为土耳其抗战募款时朗诵《答复》
1932 年拉合尔讲话：『政治根植于人的精神生活……伊斯兰不是私人意见。它是一个社会，或如你所愿，一个公民教会。』
representative_cases_en: Rumuz-i-Bekhudi (1918): the counterpart to The Secrets of the Self—as Nicholson put it, the former deals with the life of the individual Moslem, the latter with the life of the Islamic community

Shikwa and Jawab-e-Shikwa (1909/1913): a staged dialogue of complaint and divine answer forcing communal self-examination—God replies that the Muslims themselves turned from the path; the sequel was recited in 1913 at Mochi Gate, Lahore, to raise funds for Turkey
Lahore address, 1932: 'Politics have their roots in the spiritual life of Man... Islam is not a matter of private opinion. It is a society, or if you like, a civic Church.'
modern_applications_zh: 社群治理与共同体建设
社会公平议题的公共表达
modern_applications_en: Public articulation of social justice concerns

verification.evidence: The Secrets of the Self 导言（Nicholson 论两书分工）；Wikipedia 'Shikwa and Jawab-e-Shikwa'；Routledge / muslimphilosophy H037（含 1932 拉合尔讲话引文）；Pritchett 校注页（首诵年份两说）

modes.definition_zh: 把哲学愿景转译为可谈判的政治架构：1930 年阿拉哈巴德演讲中，伊克巴尔不诉诸情绪而做「结构设计」——先判定印度社会由「诸共同体」而非单一民族构成，据此论证「欧洲民主模式不可照搬」；继而提出把旁遮普、西北边省、信德与俾路支合并为「单一自治邦」的具体方案（并讨论安巴拉专区等边界微调以保护少数派），把它表述为印度的「内部均势」与伊斯兰的「复原机会」；1937 年致真纳书信进一步提出西北与孟加拉的穆斯林构成「有自决权的诸民族」。方法特征：事实优先（『真正的政治家不能忽视事实』）、分层推进（先解决共同体问题再谈中央责任）、语言克制（『我不领导政党，也不追随领袖』）。
modes.definition_en: Translating philosophical vision into negotiable political architecture: in the 1930 Allahabad Address Iqbal did structural design rather than emotion—first judging that Indian society consists of communities rather than one nation, hence 'the principle of European democracy cannot be applied to India'; then proposing a concrete scheme amalgamating Punjab, NWFP, Sind and Baluchistan into a single self-governing state (with boundary adjustments such as excluding the Ambala Division to protect minorities), framed as India's 'internal balance of power' and Islam's chance at renewal; his 1937 letters to Jinnah further argued that the Muslims of North-West India and Bengal were nations entitled to self-determination. Method traits: facts first ('true statesmanship cannot ignore facts'), layered sequencing (communal settlement before central responsibility), restrained voice ('I lead no party; I follow no leader').
modes.source_chapter: 全印穆斯林联盟阿拉哈巴德年会主席演讲（1930 年 12 月 29 日；Pritchett 校订全文，The 1930 Presidential Address）；致真纳书信（1936-1937，后结集出版）；1932 年拉合尔讲话
modes.key_quote_zh: 「对印度而言，它意味着由内部均势带来的安全与和平；对伊斯兰而言，则是一次机会——摆脱被迫套上的『阿拉伯帝国主义』印记，重新调动它的法律、教育与文化，使其与自身原初精神及现代精神更紧密地接触。」（1930 阿拉哈巴德演讲）
modes.key_quote_en: 'For India, it means security and peace resulting from an internal balance of power; for Islam, an opportunity to rid itself of the stamp that Arabian Imperialism was forced to give it, to mobilise its law, its education, its culture, and to bring them into closer contact with its own original spirit and with the spirit of modern times.' (Allahabad Address, 29 December 1930)
process_zh: 诊断社会结构：裁定印度是『诸共同体的洲陆』，同质化民族假设不成立
拒绝照搬：指出欧洲民主原理在印度的非适用性
提出方案：明确列举拟合并省份与边界微调，给出可讨论的蓝图
双重论证：同时面向印度（内部均势）与伊斯兰（复兴机会）论证正当性
分层推进：主张先解决共同体问题，再决定中央责任与联邦结构
持续升级：以书信把方案推给关键行动者，从愿景走向运动
process_en: Diagnose the social structure: rule that India is 'a continent of human groups', so the homogeneous-nation assumption fails
Refuse copy-paste: argue that European democratic principles cannot be applied to India as they stand
Draft the blueprint: name the provinces to be amalgamated and the boundary adjustments, offering a discussable scheme
Argue doubly: justify the scheme both for India (internal balance of power) and for Islam (a chance at renewal)
Sequence the steps: settle the communal question first, then central responsibility and federation design
Escalate through actors: use letters to move the scheme from vision toward movement
representative_cases_zh: 阿拉哈巴德演讲（1930）：提出『我愿看到旁遮普、西北边省、信德与俾路支合并为单一国家……一个统一的西北印度穆斯林国家，至少是西北印度穆斯林的最终命运』；同篇声明『伊斯兰不是一座教会。它是一个契约式有机体，早在卢梭之前就被构想。』
致真纳书信（1937）：劝告把注意力集中在西北印度与孟加拉，提出『穆斯林聚居省份应组成独立联邦，这是唯一能带来和平印度、并使穆斯林免于受统治的道路』
联邦结构细部设计：演讲中系统讨论西蒙报告、尼赫鲁报告、土邦参与、33% 中央席位等条款，展示『可谈判的架构家』一面
representative_cases_en: Allahabad Address (1930): 'I would like to see the Punjab, North-West Frontier Province, Sind and Baluchistan amalgamated into a single State... the formation of a consolidated North-West Indian Muslim State appears to me to be the final destiny of the Muslims'; the same speech declares that 'Islam is not a Church. It is a State conceived as a contractual organism long before Rousseau ever thought of such a thing'

Letters to Jinnah (1937): advising focus on North-West India and Bengal—'a separate federation of Muslim provinces... is the only course by which we can secure a peaceful India and save Muslims from the domination of non-Muslims'
Institutional detail work: the address systematically engages the Simon Report, the Nehru Report, the princes' participation and the 33% central-seat demand, showing Iqbal as a negotiable architect
modern_applications_zh: 多族群社会的制度安排

modes.definition_zh: 用可被千万人复述的意象，把哲学命题「下沉」为大众认知工具：伊克巴尔把抽象主张锻造成高辨识度符号——「隼鹰」（shaheen）代表自足、高飞、拒绝驯化的自我；「信士之人」（mard-e-momin）代表以爱与行动立身的理想人格；「胡迪之秘在于万物非主」（Khudi ka sirr-e-nihan la ilaha illallah）把自我哲学压缩进一句认主词。方法要点：从自然物（鹰、种子、星、灯）取材；让意象自带行为指令（『把巢筑在山岩上』即是行动纲领）；用格言化对偶句制造可背诵性；以同一意象在不同作品反复出现完成符号的公共化。
modes.definition_en: Forging images that millions can repeat, sinking philosophical propositions into popular cognition: Iqbal turned abstractions into high-recognition symbols—the falcon (shaheen) as the self that is self-reliant, high-flying and untameable; the man of faith (mard-e-momin) as the ideal personality grounded in love and action; 'the hidden secret of the self is: there is no god but God' as selfhood compressed into a single creed. Method: draw from nature (eagle, seed, stars, lamp); let each image carry a behavioural instruction ('build your nest on the crags'); coin couplets designed for memorization; repeat a symbol across works until it becomes public property.
modes.source_chapter: 《钟声集》（Bang-e-Dara, 1924）；《加百列的翅膀》『隼鹰』篇（1935）；《摩西的杖》认主词篇（1936，一说《加百列的翅膀》——集源两说待核）；《加百列游记》（1932）；『隼鹰』象征释义（转述自致 Zafar Ahmed Siddiqi 的信，转述材料）
modes.key_quote_zh: 「你是隼鹰，翱翔是你的天职；你面前的天空，还有更多。」（伊克巴尔诗行，广泛流传；集源有两说，待校勘）
modes.key_quote_en: 'You are a falcon; flight is your vocation: you have other skies stretching out before you.' (Iqbal, widely quoted; collection attribution varies—Bal-i-Jibril vs Zarb-i-Kalim, to be verified)
process_zh: 选定母题：从自然与文化传统中选出可承载哲学的生物与物象
赋予人格：让物象携带明确的价值人格（自足、勇敢、清洁）
压缩成句：把主张压缩为对偶、格言与副歌式句法，便于背诵与传唱
双重指令：让意象同时给出『是什么』与『怎么做』（飞、筑巢、扑击）
跨作复用：在不同诗集与篇章反复重铸，形成符号资产
交给公众：让意象进入学校、集会、乐唱与日常语言，完成大众化
process_en: Pick the motif: choose creatures and objects from nature and tradition that can carry philosophy
Give it personality: let the image carry a clear ethical personality (self-reliance, courage, purity)
Condense into verse: compress claims into couplets, epigrams and refrain-like syntax made for memory and song
Issue a double instruction: let the image say both what one is and what one must do (fly, nest, swoop)
Reuse across works: recast the symbol in different collections until it becomes an asset
Hand it to the public: let the image enter schools, rallies, song and everyday speech
representative_cases_zh: 『隼鹰』意象群：『你的巢不在王宫的穹顶；你是隼鹰，就把巢筑在山岩上』；『扑击、翻转、再扑击，只是让血液保持滚烫的借口』；诗人自称『鸟群世界的苦行僧，不筑巢』
『信士之人』与共同体收束句：《答复》结句『若你忠于穆罕默德，我们便属于你』把人格理想与忠诚结构绑在一起
认主词压缩：『胡迪之秘是万物非主；胡迪是把剑，认主词是磨刀石』——把自我哲学压进神学公式
representative_cases_en: The falcon cluster: 'Your nest is not on the dome of a royal palace; you are a falcon, so make your home in the crags of the mountains'; 'To swoop, withdraw and swoop again is only a pretext to keep up the heat of the blood'; the poet calls himself 'the dervish of the birds' world, who builds no nest'
The man of faith and the communal closing line: the finale of Jawab-e-Shikwa—'If you are faithful to Muhammad, we are yours'—binds the ideal personality to a structure of loyalty
Creed compressed: 'The hidden secret of selfhood is: there is no god but God; selfhood is a sword, and its whetstone is that creed'—selfhood philosophy packed into a theological formula

modes.definition_zh: 以「精神史」重读文明兴衰，把历史当作诊断与处方的来源：伊克巴尔把穆斯林文明的动力学归因于「古兰经式的经验精神」——古典世界失败在于纯内省（只有理论而没有力量），而古兰经不断召唤观察风、昼夜、云与星辰，并在蜜蜂身上看到神启的接受者，为归纳理智与实验方法奠基；他重读经典叙事（把「堕落」重释为「从本能欲求的原始状态走向拥有自由自我——能够怀疑与不服从」），把第一代共同体的成功归因于持续创制；由此得出诊断：停滞源于内省化与教条化，处方是恢复行动与观察。重读对象覆盖希腊哲学（批评其静态宇宙观）、苏非史（区分真伪神秘主义）与近代史（解释西方崛起与其他文明的相对停滞）。
modes.definition_en: Re-reading civilizational rise and fall through the history of its spirit, turning history into both diagnosis and prescription: Iqbal attributed the dynamism of Muslim culture to the Qur'anic empirical spirit—classical cultures failed because of pure introversion ('theory without power'), whereas the Qur'an constantly calls the reader to observe the winds, day and night, the clouds and the starry heavens, sees in the humble bee a recipient of Divine inspiration, and thus lays the ground for inductive intellect and experiment; he re-read classic narratives (the 'Fall' as a transition 'from a primitive state of instinctive appetite to the conscious possession of a free self, capable of doubt and disobedience') and credited the first community's success to continuous ijtihad; hence the diagnosis—stagnation comes from introversion and dogmatism—and the prescription—restore action and observation. His re-readings cover Greek philosophy (criticizing its static cosmos), Sufi history (separating genuine from pseudo-mysticism) and modern history (explaining Western ascent and relative stagnation elsewhere).
modes.source_chapter: 《宗教思想重建》第 5 讲『穆斯林文化的精神』；第 1 讲；第 6 讲；前言（『行先于思』）
modes.key_quote_zh: 「古兰经是一部强调『行』而非『思』的书。」（《宗教思想重建》前言）
modes.key_quote_en: 'The Qur'an is a book which emphasizes deed rather than idea.' (Preface, The Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam)
process_zh: 选取文明样本：以穆斯林文化史与古典文明史为对照面
定位精神气质：用『经验/观察/行动』对『内省/静观/理论』刻画兴衰机制
重释关键叙事：把『堕落』『顺从』等观念重新编码为成长与自由
追认方法先例：指出第一代共同体的创制与观察实践
给出诊断：把停滞归因于教条化、内省化与对现世的逃逸
开出处方：以行动、观察与创制重建文明的动力学
process_en: Select civilizational samples: set Muslim cultural history against classical civilizations
Profile the ethos: oppose experience/observation/action to introversion/contemplation/theory as the mechanism of rise and fall
Re-code key narratives: reinterpret 'Fall' and 'submission' as growth and freedom
Recover methodological precedents: point to the first community's practice of ijtihad and observation
Deliver the diagnosis: stagnation stems from dogmatism, introversion and flight from the world
Write the prescription: rebuild the dynamics of civilization through action, observation and ijtihad
representative_cases_zh: 『蜜蜂与风』论证：称古兰经『在卑微的蜜蜂身上看到神启的接受者，并不断召唤读者观察风的变化、昼夜交替、云、星空与行星』——以此证明伊斯兰精神是经验性的
『堕落』重释：把亚当故事解读为『从本能的欲求状态过渡到拥有自由自我——能够怀疑与不服从』，拒绝原罪叙事（《重建》1930: 85）
古典世界的诊断：『古代世界的文化失败了……它们从内部向外移动，只有理论而没有力量，而没有哪种持久文明能建立在纯理论之上』（转引自 Routledge H037）
representative_cases_en: The bee and the winds argument: the Qur'an 'sees in the humble bee a recipient of Divine inspiration and constantly calls upon the reader to observe the perpetual change of the winds, the alterations of day and night, the clouds, the starry heavens and the planets'—evidence that the Islamic spirit is empirical

Re-reading the Fall: Adam's story as 'a transition from a primitive state of instinctive appetite to the conscious possession of a free self, capable of doubt and disobedience' (Reconstruction 1930: 85)

Diagnosing the classical world: 'The cultures of the ancient world failed... they moved from within outwards, giving theory without power, and no durable civilization can be based on mere theory' (per Routledge H037)
modern_applications_zh: 传统与现代化关系梳理
modern_applications_en: Studies of civilizational and institutional rise and fall

modes.definition_zh: 按受众分层选择语言与文体的传播工程：伊克巴尔用波斯语写哲学长诗（《自我的秘密》《东方之信》《加百列游记》等），因为他的信息并非只给印度穆斯林，而是「给所有地方的穆斯林」——受过教育的穆斯林读者熟知波斯文学，波斯语尤擅表达哲学；用乌尔都语写给次大陆大众（《钟声集》《加百列的翅膀》），承载动员与教育功能；用英语写学术讲座与政论（《宗教思想重建》、演讲与书信），直接与殖民权力及世界学术界对话。策略要点：同一思想多语种重写而非直译；为高层对话配置「高语域」（波斯语长诗的庄严）、为大众配置「可诵语域」（乌尔都语歌谣与格言）、为制度对话配置「论证语域」（英语散文）；翻译网络（尼科尔森、阿伯里、席梅尔）把语域分层延伸为跨世纪传播。
modes.definition_en: A communication project that selects language and register by audience: Iqbal wrote his philosophical poems in Persian (Asrar-i Khudi, Payam-i-Mashriq, Javid Nama), because his message was 'not for the Mohammedans of India alone, but for Moslems everywhere'—educated Muslims knew Persian literature, and Persian was 'singularly well adapted to express philosophical ideas'; he wrote Urdu for the subcontinent's masses (Bang-e-Dara, Bal-i-Jibril), carrying mobilization and education; and English for academic lectures and political prose (the Reconstruction, addresses, letters), speaking directly to colonial power and world scholarship. Method: rewrite one idea across languages rather than translate literally; assign a high register (Persian mathnavi), a recitable register (Urdu song and epigram) and an argumentative register (English prose) to their audiences; the translation network (Nicholson, Arberry, Schimmel) then extends the layering across generations.
modes.source_chapter: Nicholson 英译本导言（The Secrets of the Self, 1920, p. ix）；《东方之信》序；《宗教思想重建》前言；Poetry Foundation 作品表与 PIDE 语种统计（波斯语约七成）
modes.key_quote_zh: 「他的信息不只是给印度的穆斯林，而是给所有地方的穆斯林；因此他用波斯语而非印度斯坦语写作——这是明智的选择，因为受过教育的穆斯林中有许多人熟悉波斯文学。」（尼科尔森《自我的秘密》英译本导言，1920）
modes.key_quote_en: 'His message is not for the Mohammedans of India alone, but for Moslems everywhere: accordingly he writes in Persian instead of Hindustani—a happy choice, for amongst educated Moslems there are many familiar with Persian literature.' (R. A. Nicholson, Introduction to The Secrets of the Self, 1920, p. ix)
process_zh: 界定受众层级：跨地域穆斯林知识界/南亚大众/英语知识界与殖民权力
匹配语言：分别使用波斯语、乌尔都语、英语
匹配文体：长诗与玛斯纳维/歌谣、对偶句与朗诵诗/讲座与政论散文
同源重写：同一思想以不同语言重铸，而非机械翻译
借力翻译：欢迎并协助英译（尼科尔森 1920 等），把文本送出原生语境
延续传播：由后世译者（阿伯里、席梅尔、鲍萨尼）接力，形成跨世纪语域链
process_en: Define audience layers: transregional Muslim learned public / South Asian masses / English-reading scholarship and colonial power
Match language: Persian, Urdu, English respectively
Match genre: mathnavi and long poem / song, couplet and recitation verse / lecture and political prose
Rewrite the same idea across languages rather than translating mechanically
Invite translation: welcome and assist English rendering (Nicholson 1920) to move texts beyond their native context
Continue the relay: later translators (Arberry, Schimmel, Bausani) extend the register chain across generations
representative_cases_zh: 波斯语长诗路线：1915-1932 年间以波斯语完成主要哲学诗，其波斯语作品使他赢得伊朗读者；据研究统计，其诗作约七成波斯语、三成乌尔都语（统计口径转述，待核）
乌尔都语动员路线：《钟声集》（1924）收录《怨诉—答复》《印度之歌》等，把思想送入集会、演唱与课堂
英语学术路线：1928-1930 年讲于马德拉斯、海得拉巴与阿利加尔，成书《宗教思想重建》（1930 拉合尔版/1934 牛津版）
representative_cases_en: The Persian route: the major philosophical poems were written in Persian between 1915 and 1932, winning him Iranian readers; studies count roughly seventy percent Persian verses to thirty percent Urdu (a reported statistic, to be verified)
The Urdu mobilization route: Bang-e-Dara (1924) collects Shikwa/Jawab-e-Shikwa and Tarana-e-Hindi, carrying the thought into rallies, song and classrooms
The English scholarly route: lectures delivered at Madras, Hyderabad and Aligarh in 1928-1930, published as six lectures in Lahore (1930) and as an expanded Oxford edition (1934)
modern_applications_zh: 学术写作与公共写作的分工
modern_applications_en: Dividing labour between academic and public writing

modes.definition_zh: 把作品写成「致未来」的委托书：伊克巴尔公开以「明日之诗人」自居——《自我的秘密》自白『我不需要今日之耳，我是明日诗人的声音』；《加百列游记》（1932）以儿子贾维德之名命名，结尾直接向「新世代」讲话；他写作面向儿童的歌谣（《小鸟的祈祷》《印度之歌》），并以『我爱那些把套索抛向星辰的青年』赞美青年；在制度层面，他参与教育事务（圆桌会议教育委员会工作、为喀布尔大学建设受询）。方法要点：把时间尺度拉长到「明日」；把读者设定为尚未在场的行动者；以命名、献词与呼语制造代际契约；用少年可诵的韵律降低思想入门门槛。
modes.definition_en: Writing that functions as a commission to the future: Iqbal openly styled himself the poet of to-morrow—'I have no need of the ear of To-day, I am the voice of the poet of To-morrow'; Javid Nama (1932) is named after his son Javid and closes by addressing the 'new generation'; he wrote songs for children (A Bird's Prayer; Tarana-e-Hindi) and praised the young—'My love is for those young ones who cast their lasso upon the stars'; institutionally he engaged in education (work on committees at the Round Table Conferences; consulted on the founding of Kabul University). Method: stretch the time-scale to 'to-morrow'; address readers not yet in the room; bind generations through naming, dedication and apostrophe; lower the entry threshold for thought through rhythms a child can recite.
modes.source_chapter: 《自我的秘密》自白句（尼科尔森导言引，1920）；《加百列游记》（1932）终章与题献；《加百列的翅膀》青年诗句；教育事务记录（Routledge/muslimphilosophy H037；allamaiqbal 年表）
modes.key_quote_zh: 「我不需要今日之耳；我是明日诗人的声音。」（《自我的秘密》自白，尼科尔森英译本导言引，1920）
modes.key_quote_en: 'I have no need of the ear of To-day, I am the voice of the poet of To-morrow.' (Iqbal, quoted in Nicholson's Introduction to The Secrets of the Self, 1920)
process_zh: 拉长时间尺度：把作品的收件人设定在『明日』
名义委托：以子之名命名书卷，让文本成为家书与遗嘱
呼语结构：在篇末直接向新世代致辞，制造面对面交接
降低门槛：以儿童歌谣与简单韵律承载家国与宇宙主题
赞美青年：把青年塑造成历史的行动者（『把套索抛向星辰』）
制度投入：参与教育改革与大学建设，让语言落地为机构
process_en: Stretch the time-scale: address the work to 'to-morrow'
Commission by naming: name the book after his son, making the text a family letter and a testament
Use apostrophe: close the poem by addressing the new generation directly, staging a handover
Lower the threshold: carry cosmic and civic themes in children's songs and simple metres
Praise the young: cast youth as agents of history ('who cast their lasso upon the stars')
Invest institutionally: take part in education reform and university building so the language lands in institutions
representative_cases_zh: 《加百列游记》（1932）：以儿子之名命名，穿越诸天的旅程终章向青年提供指引；他自称『活泉』（Zinda Rud），由鲁米引导
儿童诗歌实践：《小鸟的祈祷》《印度之歌》等为儿童创作，前者被视为早期动物权利主题诗
教育事务参与：圆桌会议期间参加教育相关委员会；1933 年受阿富汗政府之邀为喀布尔大学建设提供咨询
representative_cases_en: Javid Nama (1932): named after his son; the celestial journey, guided by Rumi, closes with guidance to the young generation; the poet calls himself Zinda Rud, 'a stream full of life'
Poetry for children: A Bird's Prayer and Tarana-e-Hindi were composed for children, the former read as an early poem on animal welfare
Educational engagement: service on education-related committees during the Round Table Conferences; consulted by the Afghan government on Kabul University in 1933
modern_applications_zh: 青少年教育与激励设计
